verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy publishes a public API at docs.lemonsqueezy.com/api. The docs cover test mode for full integrations, rate-limit headers, a versioning and deprecation policy, and programmatic webhook setup. A community user also independently suggests using the LS API to export customers. Probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI or llms.txt artifacts, which weakens agent-friendliness but does not contradict the API's existence. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, and evidence detailing authentication and the full endpoint/resource coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
